chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام was asked about an old animal whose front teeth had fallen out: would it suffice for the sacrificial offering?
He said: “There is no harm in offering it as a sacrifice.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يُضَحَّى: to be offered as a sacrifice

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to offer an old animal with fallen front teeth as an udhiyah sacrifice?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sacrificial animals. Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that an old animal whose front teeth have fallen out is still acceptable for the udhiyah, indicating permissibility in this case.
